title: Gemma 4 E2B/E4B temporal lineage, architecture, and footprint
question: How did the Gemma 4 family and its E2B/E4B artifacts change over time, what do their effective and retained parameter labels mean, and which architecture, memory, multimodal, MTP, QAT, and Gemma 3n lineage statements survive bounded source review?

inclusion_criteria: Retain launch and current family segments separately rather than rewriting history.
Bind parameter, memory, context, modality, protocol, and artifact facts to explicit denominators and source segments.
Carry Gemma 3n lineage only where a Gemma 4 source or implementation supports the relation.
exclusion_criteria: Do not equate PLE effective parameters with sparse MoE active parameters.
Do not infer route-level modality, context, or runtime admission from checkpoint capability.
Do not inherit MatFormer or E2B-inside-E4B nesting from Gemma 3n by label alone.

generality_probe.rationale: The run tests whether one family label remains coherent across launch time, current registry artifacts, a later technical report, and implementation-level configuration without schema changes.

clusters.label: Launch and current Gemma 4 catalogs are different temporal objects
clusters.supported_scope: The launch quartet, later MTP assistants, and later 12B Unified addition can be retained without treating the current catalog as the historical launch catalog.
transfer_limits: Provider and registry surfaces are closely related origins rather than independent capability evidence.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Future family additions and repository revisions remain mutable.
clusters.next_action: Refresh only the affected segment when a release or registry revision trigger fires.

clusters.label: PLE requires separate effective, retained, static-load, text-only, resident, and context denominators
clusters.supported_scope: E2B/E4B effective labels, retained checkpoint counts, and two provider memory tables can all be preserved when their denominators remain explicit.
transfer_limits: No measured runtime residency or peak follows from these provider and registry records.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: A component-by-component accounting and common measured runtime are absent.
clusters.next_action: Require component, format, placement, context, KV dtype, runtime, and static/resident/peak/on-disk labels in any owner study.

clusters.label: E2B and E4B share PLE, multimodal, and protocol mechanisms but differ in decoder shape
clusters.supported_scope: The two E variants share nominal context, vocabulary, modalities, PLE, and protocol surfaces while differing in layers, width, KV heads, attention cadence, and retained size.
transfer_limits: One provider origin and no end-to-end runtime admission.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Exact modality/runtime compatibility and usable context are not established.
clusters.next_action: Treat each runtime-format-modality combination as a realization-specific admission target.

clusters.label: MTP and QAT/mobile are separate realization inputs rather than intrinsic default behavior
clusters.supported_scope: Provider artifacts exist for speculative decoding and mobile-oriented quantization for both E sizes, but their performance and compatibility remain unmeasured here.
transfer_limits: Artifact existence is not route support, speedup, quality, or memory proof.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Exact assistant/QAT revisions and runtime study identities are incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Select exact target/assistant or QAT/runtime pairs only inside a named owner study.

clusters.label: Gemma 3n lineage is positive for PLE/audio and unresolved for MatFormer nesting
clusters.supported_scope: Explicit Gemma 4 sources support PLE and audio-design lineage while failing to establish Gemma 3n MatFormer or nested E2B-in-E4B inheritance.
transfer_limits: Absence of a captured statement is not proof of architectural absence.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No explicit provider confirmation or denial of Gemma 4 nesting was found.
clusters.next_action: Revisit only on an explicit provider report, implementation relation, or artifact-backed analysis.

clusters.label: Provider capability direction and resource direction occupy different axes
clusters.supported_scope: E4B is ahead on most captured provider benchmark rows while E2B has smaller retained and estimated load-memory surfaces.
transfer_limits: No accepted-outcome utility, external recurrence, runtime latency, or energy is included in this cluster.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Owner workload weights and exact runtime operating points are absent.
clusters.next_action: Carry both variants into a paired owner workload study rather than promoting one universal winner.

tensions.label: Four-model launch versus five-size current catalog
tensions.analysis: The two statements refer to different effective dates; preserving segment time resolves the apparent family-membership conflict without superseding either event.
tensions.remaining_question: What later release will next change only the current catalog?

tensions.label: E2B/E4B effective labels versus 5.12B/8.00B retained checkpoint counts
tensions.analysis: PLE effective scale and retained checkpoint parameter count answer different questions; neither can substitute for the other or for runtime residency.
tensions.remaining_question: Which retained components are placed, quantized, or omitted in each target realization?

tensions.label: Current static-load estimates versus technical-report text-only footprint
tensions.analysis: The table labels and component scopes differ, so the numeric gap is preserved as a denominator split rather than asserted as a contradiction or update.
tensions.remaining_question: Can the provider or an owner study expose a common component-by-component accounting?

tensions.label: Gemma 3n MatFormer/nesting versus Gemma 4 E-label reuse
tensions.analysis: Explicit Gemma 3n nesting cannot be inherited into Gemma 4 from labels; separate Gemma 4 class shapes create counter-pressure but do not prove non-nesting.
tensions.remaining_question: Does an authoritative Gemma 4 source establish or deny MatFormer/nested E2B-in-E4B structure?

tensions.label: E4B provider benchmark advantage versus E2B retained/load-memory advantage
tensions.analysis: Outcome and resource axes are both real and cannot be averaged without owner workload utility, accepted output, and runtime measurements.
tensions.remaining_question: Which Pareto point maximizes accepted AoA outcomes per memory, time, and energy budget?

method_pressures.pressure: A mutable current catalog can silently rewrite the remembered composition of a model-family launch.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Capture launch and later additions as separate temporal segments with independent digests and no automatic supersession.

method_pressures.pressure: Effective, active, retained, and total parameter labels are repeatedly collapsed despite different architecture semantics.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Require the parameter denominator and mechanism; never reuse PLE effective scale as MoE active scale or byte size.

method_pressures.pressure: On-disk, text-only, static load, resident, peak, and context-state values can all differ materially for one checkpoint label.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Require format, included components, overhead, placement, context, KV dtype, runtime, hardware, and measurement phase.

method_pressures.pressure: Cross-generation E2B/E4B labels invite automatic inheritance of mechanisms that may not survive the generation boundary.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Carry only explicit positive lineage and preserve missing inheritance evidence as unresolved rather than negative proof.

method_pressures.pressure: Checkpoint modality, context, QAT, and mobile labels are easily mistaken for end-to-end runtime support and device admission.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Keep weight capability, conversion/export, runtime graph, preprocessing, parser, hardware, and admission evidence as separate objects.

revisit_triggers: Google changes Gemma 4 family membership, release history, architecture, context, modality, protocol, license, memory estimates, or provider benchmark instrument.
Any E2B/E4B base, IT, MTP, QAT, or mobile repository revision changes.
An authoritative Gemma 4 source confirms or denies MatFormer or nested E2B-in-E4B lineage.
A component-level memory accounting aligns technical-report text-only and current static-load tables.
An AoA owner selects an exact E2B/E4B realization for canonical fact or study review.
